items.stem: Why is the model's context window a poor place to keep long-term memory?

options.text: It is bounded and transient, so information in it is lost and cannot grow indefinitely
options.rationale: Correct: the window has a fixed size and does not persist across sessions.

options.text: It is encrypted and cannot be read
options.rationale: The context is readable by the model; that is not the issue.

options.text: It automatically backs up to disk
options.rationale: The window is not a durable store.

options.text: It grows without limit for free
options.rationale: The window is finite, which is exactly the problem.

items.explanation: Correct: the window has a fixed size and does not persist across sessions.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO let a long-running task survive a crash and resume? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Persist task state to a durable store at checkpoints
options.rationale: Correct: durable checkpoints are what a restart reads to resume.

options.text: Make each step idempotent so re-running it is safe
options.rationale: Correct: idempotent steps allow safe resumption without double effects.

options.text: Hold all progress only in local variables
options.rationale: Local state is lost on crash.
Sampling settings do not provide durability.

items.explanation: Correct: durable checkpoints are what a restart reads to resume.

items.stem: An agent's prompts keep overflowing the context as memory grows. What is the right fix?

options.text: Retrieve only relevant memory into the prompt and compact or expire the rest
options.rationale: Correct: selective retrieval plus compaction keeps the prompt bounded.

options.text: Always load the entire memory into every prompt
options.rationale: That is the cause of the overflow, not the fix.
Removing the model does not manage memory.
Turning off the task avoids rather than solves the problem.

items.explanation: Correct: selective retrieval plus compaction keeps the prompt bounded.
